display.purpose: Home title, with a smaller mobile override.

code.purpose: Preformatted code; its family also appears in circuit output readouts.

result.purpose: One prominent result, with tabular numerals.

shadows.name: header-separation
shadows.purpose: Soft masthead separation; article, details and tables use borders or tonal layers.

motion.name: page-out
motion.purpose: Outgoing native view transition to opacity zero.

motion.name: page-in
motion.purpose: Incoming native view transition from opacity .7.

motion.name: surface-hover
motion.purpose: Background changes for the primary link, atlas, feature and details.

motion.name: noise-band
motion.purpose: Interruptible band interpolation from the displayed bounds; every frame recomputes area and RMS.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: CSS removes transitions and animations; band bounds settle immediately. Source changes are also immediate.

components.name: Primary Start Link
components.description: The home page's direct entry to MOS devices; retain link semantics.
components.html: 从 MOS 器件开始

components.name: Experiment Reset Button
components.description: A secondary native action inside a circuit experiment.
components.css: .ds-reset{color:#126e63;border:1px solid #b5ccc7;padding:.4rem .6rem;background:white;border-radius:3px;font-family:var(--md-text-font,"Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif);font-size:.68rem;min-height:2.2rem;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.ds-reset:hover{background:#eff7f5}.ds-reset:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #327aa0;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Frequency Source Select
components.description: Explicitly names live analytic and fixed precomputed data sources.
components.css: .ds-source{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap;font-family:var(--md-text-font,"Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif);font-size:.75rem;margin:1rem 0 .6rem}.ds-source label{font-weight:600}.ds-source select{font:inherit;color:#173c50;border:1px solid #aac0cb;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;min-height:2.2rem;padding:.4rem .6rem;max-width:100%;accent-color:#126e63}.ds-source select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--book-blue,#315bc5);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:44.984em){.ds-source{gap:.4rem}}

components.name: Native Frequency Slider
components.description: A native input with measured output and room for touch/pointer input.
components.css: .ds-control{margin:.6rem 0 0;font-family:var(--md-text-font,"Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif)}.ds-control label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;gap:.5rem}.ds-control output{font-family:var(--md-code-font,"Cascadia Code","Consolas",monospace);font-size:.85rem;color:#173c50;white-space:nowrap}.ds-control input{display:block;width:100%;height:2.25rem;margin:0;accent-color:#126e63;cursor:ew-resize;touch-action:pan-y}.ds-control input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #327aa0;outline-offset:3px}.ds-control input:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}

components.name: Active Chapter Navigation
components.description: Native book navigation with a quiet active row and visible focus.

components.name: Chapter Atlas Row
components.description: A ruled curriculum link whose number is actual chapter identity.

模型与积分方法

components.css: .ds-concept-figure{display:block;max-width:100%;margin:2rem 0 2.4rem;padding:.8rem 0;font-family:var(--md-text-font,"Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif)}.ds-viewport{overflow-x:auto;max-width:100%;scrollbar-color:#8ca8b5 #eff4f8}.ds-viewport>a{display:block;min-width:320px}.ds-viewport:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #315bc5;outline-offset:3px}.ds-concept-figure svg{display:block;width:100%;min-width:320px;max-width:400px;height:auto;margin:0 auto}.ds-scroll-hint{display:none;font-size:.65rem;line-height:1.7;color:#526974;margin:0 0 .6rem}.ds-concept-figure figcaption{font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.8;color:#526974;text-align:left;margin:1rem auto 0;max-width:38rem}.ds-figure-detail{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:2.2rem;margin-left:.4rem;font-size:.66rem;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.2em}@media(max-width:374px){.ds-scroll-hint{display:block}}@media print{.ds-figure-detail,.ds-scroll-hint{display:none}.ds-viewport{overflow:visible}.ds-viewport>a,.ds-concept-figure svg{min-width:0}}

narrative.overview:
The existing ink-blue and current-teal book identity provides the frame for rigorous Chinese CMOS learning. White reading paper sits within cool margins; Chinese serif headings mark the chapter structure, while system sans prose carries long explanations. Actual curriculum numbers, circuit paths and scientific plots supply the visual character.

The system is quiet during reading and responsive during an experiment. Interaction supports a specific physical judgment: change a band, inspect its variance contribution and read one primary RMS result. The full chapter remains meaningful as Markdown, without scripts, and in print. This is an extension of the incumbent MkDocs Material reading world; no replacement identity or approved visual comp is implied.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous reading on white paper within cool blue margins.
Serif Chinese chapter hierarchy paired with system sans explanations.
Actual chapter numbers, ruled atlas rows and a visible reading spine.
Circuit and spectral evidence with explicit source identity.
Native controls and brief, interruptible motion.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Scientific color identifies a curve, branch or selected region; preserve its label and meaning when extending a figure.

rules.name: The Surface Focus Rule
rules.body: Use the pale focus outline on the ink header and the blue outline on the reading surface; retain the established demo-specific outline in circuit controls.

rules.name: The Reading and Measurement Rule
rules.body: Keep sustained prose in the sans reading face. Use tabular numerals for tables, controls and measured results; do not apply them as a general decorative treatment.

rules.name: The Reading Spine Rule
rules.body: Keep native chapter navigation, contents, running chapter identity and the reading-progress line aligned with continuous article reading. Chapter numbers represent the actual curriculum sequence.

rules.name: The Figure Reading Rule
rules.body: A reader can identify the figure, read its caption and open the original image without relying on a script; narrow causal diagrams keep their label size inside a focusable, diagram-local scroll region.

rules.name: The Shared Select Rule
rules.body: Native source selectors keep an associated visible label, a minimum height of 2.2rem (44px at a 20px root size), a visible blue focus outline and the existing white field treatment.

dos: **Do** preserve native MkDocs navigation, search, math, disclosure semantics and the complete static reading path.
**Do** pair scientific colors with explicit labels and retain a figure's source identity.
**Do** keep the primary noise result synchronized with the displayed selected band.
**Do** provide a visible focus treatment appropriate to its adjacent surface.
**Do** retain the one-column reading measure and stack experiment controls at the existing mobile breakpoint.
donts: **Don't** substitute decorative interface structure for a derivation, circuit or scientific plot.
**Don't** present fixed precomputed process data as a live simulation.
**Don't** animate between different data sources or require motion to understand a result.
**Don't** make scripts or externally downloaded fonts a prerequisite for reading.
